name: LeReMix: Depth-Recurrent Mixture of Experts
author: benjamintd
blurb: Universal Transformer-style depth recurrence (12 virtual layers from 1 physical block) with 64-expert MoE including a parameter-free passthrough expert for implicit ACT. Timestep embeddings enable depth-aware routing. SigReg distributional regularization prevents MoE collapse. Dual optimizer: Muon + AdamW. int6+zlib compression.
